P01.target_owner: backend shared services and protected React/Inertia POS administration
P01.target_gate: Cross-role and cross-outlet direct requests denied; credential/reset/session behavior and historical shop ownership retained.
P01.decision: Migrate identities with explicit collision maps; adapt guards/controllers; reuse permission checks. Do not equate POS outlet User with Website customer.

P02.target_owner: backend shared services and protected React/Inertia POS administration
P02.target_gate: Category-aware validation, identifier uniqueness, disabled-option history and managed-option deletion safeguards match source assertions.
P02.decision: Reuse registries and validators; migrate IDs/options/usage; adapt persistence to shared schema. No category redesign.

P03.target_owner: backend shared services and protected React/Inertia POS administration
P03.target_gate: MySQL concurrent sale/reserve/return proves no oversell, duplicate IMEI or movement; rollback and inventory totals reconcile.
P03.decision: Reuse stock rules; refactor controller transactions into shared services; migrate units/movements. Preserve app-owned availability states.

P04.target_owner: backend shared services and protected React/Inertia POS administration
P04.target_gate: Legacy sale and negative flows, precise totals, returns, stock/accounting changes, historical invoices and permissions match.
P04.decision: Reuse arithmetic and snapshots; refactor transactional controller work; migrate history; adapt React forms and print bindings.

P05.target_owner: backend shared services and protected React/Inertia POS administration
P05.target_gate: Expiry boundaries, claim lifecycle and role denial, old/new clause snapshots and document output retained.
P05.decision: Reuse clause validation/snapshot services; migrate claim/history relations; adapt interface.

P06.target_owner: backend shared services and protected React/Inertia POS administration
P06.target_gate: Role-scoped totals/CSV, filters and date boundaries; A4/80mm print/download; protected placeholders and safe communication links.
P06.decision: Reuse query/formatting/template contracts; adapt shared services and React screens. Preserve historical snapshot output.

P07.target_owner: backend shared services and protected React/Inertia POS administration
P07.target_gate: Per-section and publish permission checks, draft isolation, safe upload/path rules, cache invalidation, audit and rollback parity.
P07.decision: Reuse settings registries and sanitizers; adapt runtime presentation from Blade to Inertia; migrate revisions/media usage.

P08.target_owner: backend shared services and protected React/Inertia POS administration
P08.target_gate: Isolated backup/restore and failure tests; no secrets in audit/errors; ownership guards; recovery controls and scheduled job disablement.
P08.decision: Reuse manifest/redaction guards; adapt storage/process paths and shared-schema backup. Keep destructive reset separately guarded, never auto-run.

X01.target_owner: backend shared transactional services and REST contracts
X01.target_gate: Same request replay, conflicting request hashes, expiry/confirm/release races, partial failure/retry and order-stock-payment reconciliation on MySQL.
X01.decision: Reuse state machine/contract validations; refactor transport into shared Laravel transactions. Retire dual-database transport only after replacement acceptance, never its invariants.

W01.target_owner: backend services/protected CMS plus website Next.js REST client
W01.target_gate: Guest/customer/admin cross-role denial, account ownership, signed-link expiry, profile upload limits, last-owner safety and password reset parity.
W01.decision: Reuse policy/validation and session boundaries; migrate identity mapping; adapt CMS administration into backend and public account into Next.js.

W02.target_owner: backend services/protected CMS plus website Next.js REST client
W02.target_gate: Same category/filter/variant/price results, private fields never public, zero stock handled correctly, POS writes reflected through APIs and redirects retained.
W02.decision: Reuse query/presentation/public allowlist contracts; replace copied POS catalogue with shared-authority reads only after freshness parity; adapt Next pages.

W03.target_owner: backend services/protected CMS plus website Next.js REST client
W03.target_gate: Guest-to-account/cart recovery, quantity/price changes, duplicate submit, ownership, signed access, eligible purchase review and moderation.
W03.decision: Reuse validation/ownership/review rules; migrate records and snapshots; adapt session cart and REST/Next interfaces.

W04.target_owner: backend services/protected CMS plus website Next.js REST client
W04.target_gate: Amount/owner/reference tampering and replay denied; COD works; hosted gateway fakes prove contract only; authentic provider sandbox remains H-02.
W04.decision: Reuse provider interfaces, verification and disabled-provider failures; adapt persistence/URLs; no invented gateway implementation or raw PAN/CVV collection.

W05.target_owner: backend services/protected CMS plus website Next.js REST client
W05.target_gate: Approved quote amount cannot be changed by client, ownership/token expiry and request privacy hold, status/history and paid linkage preserved.
W05.decision: Reuse quote/request validation and signed access; migrate service/quote/order relationships; adapt CMS and Next public flows.

W06.target_owner: backend services/protected CMS plus website Next.js REST client
W06.target_gate: Draft isolation, protected route collisions, safe markup/URLs/media, ordering/visibility, publication/rollback and cache invalidation match.
W06.decision: Reuse registries/sanitization/revision services; migrate content; adapt admin and Next rendering. Keep publication and rollback semantics.

W07.target_owner: backend services/protected CMS plus website Next.js REST client
W07.target_gate: Secret masking/key mismatch, unsafe SVG/path rejection, usage-aware deletion/replacement, theme contrast/responsive fallbacks and revision recovery.
W07.decision: Reuse registries and recovery guards; migrate logical namespace and usage; adapt admin UI and public rendering.

W08.target_owner: backend integration jobs, audit and operational health
W08.target_gate: No arbitrary endpoint/command execution, disabled integration makes no call, fake retry/failure tests and scheduler/queue recovery; local mark-paid never production API.
W08.decision: Adapt health checks to one backend; retain recovery jobs where external I/O remains; retire obsolete polling only with recorded replacement evidence.

B01.target_owner: brand canonical masters; generated backend/website runtime derivatives
B01.target_gate: Master hashes and asset manifest, view/style/build references, fallback dimensions and print contrast verified in both target applications.
B01.decision: Deduplicate byte-identical masters into root brand later; retain runtime derivatives only when referenced. Do not migrate old Control logo as approved artwork.

C01.target_gate: Exact target PID/path ownership, occupied ports/stale PIDs, repeated all-actions, partial failure, no orphan/duplicate tabs, no source/unrelated process termination.
C01.decision: Adapt useful C# UI; refactor process ownership and hard-coded paths. Port-only taskkill is unsafe; executable mirrors/launcher backup are not authoritative target source.

Q01.target_owner: backend tests, website Playwright and .github monorepo CI
Q01.target_gate: Fresh target PHPUnit/Pest, MySQL concurrency, builds and Playwright; no source tests quoted as target results; all registered capabilities independently close.
Q01.decision: Adapt fixtures/tests for shared schema and new UI incrementally; reuse assertions. Replace source-text Blade checks with behavior plus target structure checks where appropriate.

F01.target_owner: backend foundation, website build contracts and .github
F01.target_gate: Shared schema collision/foreign key map, fresh setup and migration apply/rollback/reapply, exact toolchain locks, monorepo CI and environment isolation.
F01.decision: Reuse Laravel13 foundation, adapt shared migrations/config/CI, install dependencies fresh. React/Next presentation adapters are new; business logic rewrite is not justified.

H01.target_owner: docs migration evidence and operational runbooks
H01.target_gate: Every required legacy behavior traced to target evidence; stale instructions cannot override Goal, Preferences or new registry.
H01.decision: Retain inventory/hash references; migrate only useful current runbooks. Source roadmap/old launch paths and duplicate documents are historical.
